capabilities: Embed a task app in any note with a code block
Create multiple independent task spaces by id
Organize tasks into projects with Today, Tomorrow, Week, and All views
Set P1-P4 priorities and edit and complete tasks inline
Attach task notes stored as Markdown files in the vault
extras: The README lists current limitations (no recurring tasks, notifications, calendar sync, Todoist sync, natural-language dates, or collaboration). The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: designed for people who want the convenience of Todoist while keeping their data private and local inside Obsidian
motivation: The author built it around the idea that task setup in Obsidian takes too much work: "Drop a block into a note and get a full task app instantly."
problem: Task management in Obsidian normally requires custom templates, tags, Dataview queries, and personal conventions, or turning to an external todo app.

relations.evidence: Designed for people who want the convenience of Todoist while keeping their data private and local

summary: Embeds a Todoist-style local-first task manager into any note via a code block, with projects, dates, priorities, and task notes stored in the vault.
